lines.zh: 比迪丽在原地换了下脚
lines.en: Videl shifts her weight from foot to foot.

lines.zh: 她只是从门边挪到窗边
lines.en: She only moves from the door to the window.
Her steps barely make a sound.
She circles once around the table.
She glances toward the doorway.

lines.zh: 她走到墙边，又转身回来
lines.en: She walks to the wall and turns back.

lines.zh: 她的靴子在地板上轻响
lines.en: Her boots tap lightly on the floor.

lines.zh: 她让开身位，好让你进来
lines.en: She steps aside so you can enter.

lines.zh: 她移到光线更好的地方
lines.en: She moves into better light.
She goes to the door and waits.

lines.zh: 她退到桌后，理了理衣服
lines.en: She backs behind the desk and smooths her clothes.
Her steps stay within the room.
She paces two steps, hands behind her back.
She returns to her original spot.
Videl stands with folded arms.

lines.zh: 她靠着门框等了一会儿
lines.en: She leans on the doorframe a while.

lines.zh: 她低头看了看自己的手
lines.en: She looks down at her hands.

lines.zh: 她抬手把头发别到耳后
lines.en: She tucks her hair behind her ear.
She lets out a small sigh.
She looks out at the street.
She rolls her neck.
She flattens a corner of the map.

lines.zh: 她看起来在等人来问话
lines.en: She looks like she is waiting for someone to ask.
She sits down by the desk.
She adjusts her cuffs.

lines.zh: 她敲了敲桌面，像在计时
lines.en: She taps the desk as if keeping time.
She looks up at the rafters.
Her silence takes up the whole room.

lines.zh: 比迪丽抬头，看着你走过来
lines.en: Videl looks up as you approach.

lines.zh: 她先看了你的手，再看脸
lines.en: Her eyes go to your hands, then your face.
She nods once in greeting.
She takes you for someone with a question.
She leans in, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 她扫了一眼你身上的装备
lines.en: She glances over your gear.
She gestures toward the desk.

lines.zh: 她的神情从戒备松下来
lines.en: Her guard eases.
She watches you, waiting for business.
She turns square to listen properly.

lines.zh: 她大概猜到了你的来意
lines.en: She probably guesses why you came.

lines.zh: 她抬手示意你靠近一点
lines.en: She waves you a little closer.
Her look is entirely forthright.

lines.zh: 她微微笑了下，等你说话
lines.en: She smiles slightly and waits.
She brushes the hair from her forehead.
She does not rush you; she merely waits.
Videl takes the hit and steps back.
She frowns and shields the spot.
She grits her teeth and stays quiet.
She backs against the desk.
Her breathing catches once.
Her look at you turns cold.
She straightens, still unyielding.
She tells you lowly to stop.

lines.zh: 她把被打歪的衣领拉正
lines.en: She pulls her collar straight.
She edges a step toward the door.

lines.zh: 比迪丽看了看你递来的东西
lines.en: Videl looks at what you hold out.

lines.zh: 她摇头，说自己不缺这个
lines.en: She shakes her head; she is not short of it.
She takes it and says she will remember.
Smiling, she pushes it back to you.
She puts it in a drawer.

lines.zh: 她问你还有没有别的事
lines.en: She asks if there is anything else.

lines.zh: 她把东西放在桌上，没用
lines.en: She sets it on the desk, untouched.

lines.zh: 她说这些留给更需要的人
lines.en: She says to leave that for those who need it.
She accepts it while shaking her head.
She steers the talk back to business.

lines.zh: 你碰了比迪丽一下，她让开
lines.en: You bump Videl and she gives way.
She puts out a hand to steady you.
The nudge costs her half a step.

lines.zh: 她皱眉看你，但没有发作
lines.en: She frowns but says nothing.
She turns and clears the doorway.
Arms folded, she retreats behind the desk.

lines.zh: 她的靴跟在地上磕了一下
lines.en: Her heel clicks on the floor.

lines.zh: 她抬手挡了一下你的手臂
lines.en: She lifts a hand to block your arm.

lines.zh: 她低头检查衣服有没有皱
lines.en: She checks that her clothes are not creased.
She settles and waits for your reason.

lines.zh: 比迪丽和同伴低声说话
lines.en: Videl speaks quietly with her partner.
She rests a hand on their shoulder.

lines.zh: 她们靠在一起看同一张地图
lines.en: They lean over the same map.

lines.zh: 她指了指地图上的一个点
lines.en: She points to a spot on the map.

lines.zh: 对方说了句什么，她笑了
lines.en: Her partner says something and she laughs.
She fixes her partner's collar.

lines.zh: 她把手里的东西分给对方一半
lines.en: She shares what she holds, half and half.

lines.zh: 她们同时抬头看向门口
lines.en: Both look up at the door together.

lines.zh: 她退后半步，让对方先走
lines.en: She steps back so her partner goes first.

lines.zh: 这间屋子暂时属于她们
lines.en: For now the room belongs to them.

lines.zh: 比迪丽把东西捡起来放好
lines.en: Videl picks it up and sets it away.
She checks it and puts it in a drawer.
She stacks the letters neatly.

lines.zh: 她把东西推到桌角给你
lines.en: She slides it to the corner of the desk for you.
She bends down, quick and clean.

lines.zh: 她把掉的东西都归回原位
lines.en: She returns everything to its place.

lines.zh: 她拾起地上的纸，看了看
lines.en: She picks up the paper and reads it.
She carries it against her chest.
She lifts it, then sets it down.

lines.zh: 她把你落下的东西递回来
lines.en: She hands back what you dropped.
Videl straightens all at once.

lines.zh: 她把手从桌上收了回来
lines.en: She pulls her hands from the desk.
She blocks the doorway.
Her tone turns serious.
She raises a hand for you to stop.
Her eyes track you without a break.

lines.zh: 她压低声音，警告了一句
lines.en: She warns you, voice low.

lines.zh: 她往后退，护住了身后的门
lines.en: She backs up to shield the door behind her.

lines.zh: 她抬手护在胸前，准备应对
lines.en: Her guard comes up, ready.
She has stopped smiling.

lines.zh: 比迪丽拦在你和门之间
lines.en: Videl stands between you and the door.
Her weight settles a little lower.
She watches your hands without blinking.
She retreats a step at a time.
She is looking for a way out of the room.
Her breathing stays steady.

lines.zh: 她把桌上的东西扫到一边
lines.en: She sweeps the desk clear.
She keeps side-on, an exit behind her.

lines.zh: 她低声说这不是好主意
lines.en: She mutters that this is a bad idea.
She is waiting for you to relent.

lines.zh: 比迪丽抬手挡开你的攻击
lines.en: Videl knocks your strike aside.

lines.zh: 她推了你一把，只为脱身
lines.en: A shove, only to get clear.

lines.zh: 她反手一掌，打在你手腕
lines.en: A backhand snaps at your wrist.
She slips aside and bumps you off balance.
A knee checks your thigh.
She strikes and darts behind the desk.

lines.zh: 她抓住你的手腕往下压
lines.en: She grips your wrist and presses it down.

lines.zh: 她只想把你逼退，不想伤人
lines.en: She only wants distance, not blood.
Breathing hard, she raises her hands again.
She shouts at you to stop.
Videl is standing by the door.
She looks up from behind the desk.
She rolls the map up and stows it.
She sets down the pen she was holding.
She turns to face the doorway.
She pushes the chair back.
She looks like she has been waiting.
She smooths her hem and stands ready.
She looks up at whoever comes in.
She waves you over.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到衣角，她慌忙拍打
lines.en: Fire catches her hem; she slaps at it.

lines.zh: 她摔在地上，手撑了一下
lines.en: She hits the floor and catches herself on a hand.
Water chokes her into coughing.
The blast throws her against the wall.

lines.zh: 箭划破她的袖子，渗出血
lines.en: An arrow tears her sleeve and draws blood.
Odd force hits; she presses a hand to her head.
Hunger makes her unsteady on her feet.
Lightning drops her to her knees.

lines.zh: 虚空拽住她，她拼命抓住桌沿
lines.en: The void pulls; she grips the desk edge.
